text: The first tape box shall play a household recording from a card.
The harness shall round-trip NaN, both infinities and null, and keep an absent field absent.
The watcher shall not report a card gone while it stays on the pad through missed reads.
The watcher shall report a removed card gone within 1.25 s of its last good read.
With two tags in the field the box shall play nothing.
The box shall treat each safely named folder with decodable files as a title, its tracks in name order.
The box shall identify a card by its tape pointer, else by its UID.
A new card shall bind to the first unbound title when placed.
A binding shall never change, and nothing under /tape/audio shall be written.
A power cut during a bind shall leave the previous or the new bindings.
With no bindings file that parses, the box shall restore its flash mirror and log it.
The box shall log each boot, bind and finished title.
